records.description: Arcwave turns known webnovels — cultivation, progression fantasy, LitRPG, Korean & Chinese web fiction — into streaming audiobooks you listen to chapter by chapter. 125+ narrated titles, consistent narration, progress sync across devices, lock-screen playback, and a request queue where listeners vote on what gets narrated next. The first 10 chapters of every novel are free with no sign-in; $5/month removes the daily cap.

records.name: Textual Chef
records.tagline: Text only recipes
records.description: Textual Chef is a plain-text cooking reference: 2,000+ recipes with quantities printed inside each step, one control to scale any batch, and no ads or pop-ups.

records.name: Sermly
records.tagline: AI that turns sermons into smart notes.
records.description: Sermly is an AI-powered sermon note-taking app that helps churchgoers stay present on Sunday. Record any sermon and Sermly transcribes it and automatically structures it into organized notes - Theme, Scripture references, and Key Points — alongside the full transcript. It also includes Emmaus, a built-in AI study companion you can ask questions about anything you've recorded. Free extended trial for early waitlist members.

records.name: MarketStart
records.tagline: Go to Marketing Strategy for builders and founder
records.description: MarketStart helps you create a complete go-to-market strategy in under 5 minutes by answering 12 questions about your product. It provides a brand story, customer profiles, website plan, and content plan. Start for free and unlock the full report.

records.name: RockCam
records.tagline: AI-powered photo booth software for Windows with Canon DSLR
records.description: RockCam is professional photo booth software for Windows, built for event photographers, studios, and rental operators. Key features: - AI face swap and multi-person face restoration (5+ people in one shot) - AI background removal - Native Canon DSLR camera support for professional image quality - Instant photo sharing via QR code - Live event gallery - Instant on-site printing - Custom branded photo frames and overlays - Built-in ad slots for on-screen sponsor placement

records.name: Banquish — Make the web your workspace
records.tagline: Clip living pieces of the web onto one canvas
records.description: Banquish is a Mac app that turns any website into a workspace. Pull the pieces you need onto one canvas, keep them live, and let an agent run the errands.

records.name: Futbol Libre
records.tagline: Resultados, Estadísticas y Fútbol en Vivo
records.description: Fútbol Libre es la aplicación ideal para seguir el fútbol en tiempo real. Consulta marcadores en vivo, calendarios, clasificaciones, estadísticas de equipos y jugadores, alineaciones, eventos del partido y mucho más. Recibe notificaciones instantáneas, explora competiciones de todo el mundo y mantente al día con cada partido desde una aplicación rápida, sencilla y fácil de usar.

records.name: PtyXL
records.tagline: Your servers, your machine, your control
records.description: PtyXL is a blazing-fast, local-first SSH, SFTP client. Multi-grid layout, zero-lag rendering. Your keys and configs never leave your machine.

records.name: StepWind
records.tagline: StepWind — an "undo button" for your whole Windows PC.
records.description: StepWind protects Windows PCs against accidental moves, renames, deletes, and bad saves — with continuous version history for the folders you choose. Free, open source, 100% local. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.

records.name: Proxium
records.tagline: Lists, Tasks, Calendar & Bills
records.description: Proxium is the all-in-one household app for shopping lists, tasks, bills, budgets and loyalty cards. One-time purchase. No subscription.

records.name: HrProbe
records.tagline: HR & HRMS Software
records.description: HrProbe is an AI-powered HRMS and payroll platform that helps businesses automate HR operations, manage employees, and simplify workforce management. Features include payroll, attendance, leave management, Employee Self Service (ESS), compliance, analytics, and workflow automation. Built for startups, SMEs, and enterprises, HrProbe supports multi-country and multi-state organizations with a secure, scalable, cloud-based solution.

records.name: MirrorCut
records.tagline: See your next haircut before you get it.
records.description: Upload a selfie, preview realistic men’s and women’s hairstyles on your face, and get style notes for your barber. Sign up for two free looks—no card required.

records.name: LeadPedlar
records.tagline: P2P Data Sales, Escrow & Smart Lead Distribution System
records.description: The ultimate P2P data marketplace and lead distribution engine. Buy and sell verified databases with crypto escrow security, track real-time agent lead usage, and export contacts directly to Zapier, Make, and CRMs.

records.name: Thuis Italiaans
records.tagline: learn Italian with a scientific method, easily every day
records.description: From zero to C2 along the official European levels. Every level has stages for grammar, vocabulary, culture and comprehension, with checkpoints and level exams. You always know where you are and what's needed for the next step, in 14 languages.

records.name: PriceSnap
records.tagline: Snap a photo to see what anything is worth
records.description: Find out how much it is worth in seconds. Take a picture, scan a barcode, or describe an item and get a market-backed value range with real comps — free.

records.name: ClipUtils
records.tagline: Your files never leave your browser
records.description: Trim, compress, and convert video instantly in your browser. Free, no watermark, no sign-up required. Files stay on your device.

records.name: Archwise
records.tagline: Describe your idea. Get a real Cloud architecture.
records.description: Describe your product idea in plain language and get a genuinely-reasoned multi-cloud architecture — AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes — with real cost estimates, a deterministic security/compliance audit, and ready-to-run Terraform or Kubernetes config.

records.name: Pizza Edition
records.tagline: Online and Free HTML5 Games
records.description: Play free HTML5 games in your browser! Featuring popular games like Among Us, Fireboy and Watergirl, Geometry Dash, and more.

records.name: ClipNova
records.tagline: AI video creation and image generation.
records.description: Create & edit AI videos with ClipNova. Generate viral shorts, ads, avatars and trends, no camera, no editing skills required. Free to start.

records.name: PDFly
records.tagline: 56 free PDF tools that run right in your browser
records.description: 56 free PDF tools that run in your browser. Merge, split, compress, convert, sign & chat with PDFs — no uploads, no watermarks, no account.

records.name: DearVarsity
records.tagline: Best Varsity Jackets & Letter Jackets
records.description: Discover our collection of Varsity and Letter Jackets for both men and women, Shop school, sports and inspired TV series and movies.

records.name: Vice Vault
records.tagline: Interactive GTA 6 database, cheat codes & creator tools.
records.description: The ultimate interactive GTA 6 intelligence hub. Features instant-filter cheat codes, money meta guides, and custom tools for creators (like our OG image generator and SEO meta analyzer). Updated weekly.

records.name: OrbitEquip
records.tagline: Scan. Check Out. Done.
records.description: OrbitEquip is simple tool and equipment tracking software. Check tools in and out with a quick QR scan from any phone. Free trial, no credit card.

records.name: MetaCraft Studio
records.tagline: Instant Open Graph social share card builder
records.description: MetaCraft is a browser-based visual studio that generates high-converting 1200x630 social share cards for Twitter, Telegram, LinkedIn, and Discord in 10 seconds. Built for developers and indie hackers who want to kill monthly subscriptions.

records.name: PixRGBCatch
records.tagline: Fastest way capture color around you
records.description: PixRGBCatch is the fastest way to capture and identify colors around you. Point your camera at anything — tap to grab a single pixel color, or long-press to get the average color of an area. Select a photo from your library and extract colors from any image.

records.name: ARUSA
records.tagline: Ghar ka Smartest Member — your AI household companion
records.description: ARUSA scans your grocery bills, learns what your household buys, and tells you what's running low before you shop. Shared shopping lists keep the whole family in sync, and one tap sends your list to Blinkit, Zepto, or BigBasket. Built for Indian households. Free beta — we're early and building openly, so honest feedback shapes what comes next.

records.name: Free Image Compressor Online
records.tagline: Compress Images Online for Free Reduce JPG, PNG & WebP Size
records.description: Compress JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP images online for free without installing software. Reduce image file size while maintaining quality. Fast, secure, and processed directly in your browser.

records.name: CalcLeaf
records.tagline: Free browser-based tools: calculators, PDF, dev tools
records.description: CalcLeaf is a free collection of 170+ browser-based tools — calculators (finance, health, math), text tools, PDF tools, and developer tools (JSON/JWT converters, formatters, generators, and more). Everything runs entirely client-side — nothing you enter or upload is ever sent to a server. No ads, no tracking, no sign-up required. Built and maintained solo, with a focus on speed and privacy over ad-heavy clutter. Would love feedback on what's missing!

records.name: Focus Helper Worksheet for Kids Ages 5
records.tagline: 50 Fun Activities to Build Kids' Focus & Executive Skills
records.description: Focus Helper Worksheet is a premium educational workbook featuring 50 engaging activities that help children ages 5–10 strengthen attention, concentration, executive functioning, planning, memory, self-control, and problem-solving. Designed for parents, teachers, homeschool families, tutors, and therapists, every page encourages confidence, creativity, and lifelong learning through fun, hands-on exercises.
